summary: Publishes the input TOP texture locally through Spout on Windows or Syphon on macOS.
common_gotchas: The output only sends while Active is enabled.
Syphon ignores high-depth format intent because it is 8-bit RGBA-limited.
Spout on Windows requires an Nvidia or AMD GPU; Intel-only does not work.
Shared memory works only on the same computer, so use Touch Out or NDI for network workflows.
key_concepts: Syphon Spout Out shares an input texture through local shared memory.
Spout on Windows can share higher-depth formats up to 32-bit float RGBA, while Syphon is limited to 8-bit RGBA.
The sender is local to the machine and is not a network transport.
The Sender Name is the discovery name receivers use to attach.
